verdict.rationale: Sardine documents initial and ongoing daily PEP screening alongside OFAC sanctions and adverse media, with alerts when customers land on lists and tunable fuzzy-match thresholds. Its marketing also mentions AI agents doing 'supporting research' and 'explainable scores' on matches, which only thinly addresses source context. Missing for 10: any evidence of relatives/close-associate (RCA) identification, documented per-match source records or citations backing PEP hits, details on PEP data coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
